title: Timed inhibit on ROM bin sprayer to prevent always on operation with rock breaker

fields.equipment: ROM bin sprays, rock breaker position sensor
fields.latestPosition: Timed inhibit on ROM bin sprayer to prevent always on operation with rock breaker
fields.statusConflict: DocuSign completed 16/09/2026; Initiator blank in register – Thomas Hoffman taken from form
fields.why: Rom bin sprays continuously while the rock breaker is in position unless put in manual off. This change will put a timer so if the sensor does not clear the sprays only operate for one cycle then remain off until it clears again. This will mean they can be left in auto and eliminate potential to be left in manual off state.
fields.design:
Instate a timer / inhibit so when the sensor is triggered, the sprays operate for a set period then don't operate again until the sensor clears and gets re-triggered. Looking to keep functionality for loader and prevent constant water spraying into bin when rock breaker is operating in sensor range.

[Text extracted from the DocuSign PDF – the order of the reason and proposed-change boxes should be checked against the source document]
fields.impact: Sprays can be left in Auto; they run one cycle while the rock breaker is in position.
